rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` has the front matter that marks a bundled skill, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement only obliges a skill to say when to read a file it links to. It does not oblige a skill to link anything.

The skill has no Markdown links. It points to other files only in inline code, in two places, and each one says when to read the file:
- In step 3 (Review), the subagent is told to read this skill's `references/review-prompt.md`. The trigger is starting a review subagent for a group of requirements, or reviewing the group yourself against that prompt.
- In "Choosing references", `references/fixme.md` of the habeas-evidence skill is named for deferring a requirement gap the user agrees to.

The skill also names the habeas skill's `SKILL.md` and the "Testing and coverage artifacts" section. Each is mentioned where its use applies, for example for directive and reference syntax or for coverage exceptions. I found no pointer to specialized material that lacks a "when to read" statement. The site meets the requirement.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
